title: Seller Performance Standing — Recent Serious Violations and the Points That Can Be Retired at Closing
content:
**Basis rule.** Which points can be retired depends on how recent the seller's serious violations are: for a seller with a serious violation recorded in the last twelve whole calendar months the retirement acts on the listing-type points at closing plus half of the serious points at closing, the half rounded down to a whole point; for a seller whose most recent serious violation was recorded twelve to twenty-three whole calendar months before the closing date it acts on the listing-type points plus three quarters of the serious points, rounded down; for every other seller it acts on all the active points at closing.

This governs the retirement of points when a seller closes the selling account under Seller Performance Standing. Serious violations are intellectual property, inauthentic complaint, product authenticity and review manipulation violations. Whole calendar months are counted by calendar date back from the closing date.

## Terms

- **Listing-type points at closing** — points recorded for listing policy and restricted product violations, less every point reversed, expired, stepped down or relieved on entries carrying those types.
- **Serious points at closing** — the same for the four serious types.
- **Active points at closing** — the same for every violation on the record.

## Decision table

| Whole months from the most recent serious violation to the closing date | Retirement acts on |
|---|---|
| 0 to 11 | listing-type points, plus half of the serious points rounded down |
| 12 to 23 | listing-type points, plus three quarters of the serious points rounded down |
| 24 or more, or no serious violation on record | all the active points at closing |

## Worked figures (hypothetical: listing-type points 4, serious points 5, active points 9)

- Serious violation eleven whole months before closing: 4 plus half of 5 (2.5, rounded down to 2) is 6.
- Most recent serious violation fifteen whole months before closing: 4 plus three quarters of 5 (3.75, rounded down to 3) is 7.
- Most recent serious violation thirty whole months before closing: 9.
